defective_pattern: Assuming list numbers are stored as literal text in OpenXML runs rather than paragraph properties numPr
why_defective: Causes text matching to fail for numbered paragraphs, resulting in 0 replacements or AssertionErrors
observed_symptoms: Silent matching failures when searching for paragraph text starting with numbering prefixes
corrective_remedy: Search for exact run text stripped of assumed OpenXML numPr prefixes or match by paragraph content normalized of numPr.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Searching for list numbers in run text
